<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Take the information below and generate an [NAME].instructions.md file in the /.github/instructions/ directory. Generate an appropriate name for the [NAME] placeholder filename based on the generated content. The instructions should be concise, clear, and specific to the layer of architecture or coding standards described in the input. If no information is provided below, prompt the user to give the necessary details about the layer of architecture or coding standards for which the instructions should be generated.
The .md file should have a frontmatter with the following attributes: description. The description informs the copilot of when to use this set of instructions. The body of the .md file should contain detailed instructions, guidelines, and best practices related to the specified layer of architecture or coding standards. Use markdown formatting for clarity and organization, including headings, bullet points, code snippets, and tables as needed to effectively communicate the information.
